guides.title: Rate limiting with a token bucket
guides.excerpt: Each request spends a token; the bucket refills at a steady rate, so short bursts are fine but the long-run rate stays capped.

guides.title: Stacks & monotonic stacks
guides.excerpt: Remember data in a Last-In, First-Out (LIFO) order to process immediate dependencies.

guides.title: Union-Find (DSU)
guides.excerpt: Group elements into sets and instantly check if two items belong to the same group.
